verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI (npm install -g cline) that runs interactively or headlessly in the terminal, reacting live to command output for dev servers/tests/deploys, with autonomous execution and scheduling support. Community evidence corroborates real terminal-based agentic use (e.g., controlling terminal commands, daily-driving it). Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of the CLI specifically (most community quotes reference the editor extension rather than terminal CLI) and detailed terminal UX/output examples beyond docs claims.
